title: Types of teeth and how to care for them

steps.say: Teeth break food into small pieces so we can swallow it. Different teeth do different jobs.
Incisors at the front cut and bite. Canines are pointed, and they grip and tear.
Premolars and molars at the back are wide and flat. They crush and grind food.
Children have 20 milk teeth. Adults usually have 32 adult teeth.
steps.show: 20 milk teeth → up to 32 adult teeth

steps.say: Bacteria feed on sugar and make acid that damages enamel. Brush twice a day with fluoride toothpaste.
Animal teeth match their food. Meat eaters have sharp teeth, and plant eaters have flat, grinding teeth.

check.prompt: Which teeth cut and bite food?

options.why: Molars grind food at the back.

hints: Think about biting into an apple.
These teeth are at the front of your mouth.
They are thin and sharp, like little blades.
check.explanation: Incisors are the sharp front teeth. They cut and bite food.

check.prompt: An adult usually has 32 teeth. A child has 20 milk teeth. How many more teeth does an adult usually have?
hints: How many more means find the difference.
Take the child number away from it.
check.explanation: 32 take away 20 is 12, so an adult usually has 12 more teeth.
